content: Air pollution can result from vehicle exhaust, industrial emissions, dust, and burning waste. Reducing emissions and avoiding open waste burning can help improve air quality.

Water pollution can occur when sewage, chemicals, and other waste enter rivers, lakes, or groundwater. Preventing waste disposal into water bodies and managing wastewater appropriately can help protect water quality.
source_name: World Health Organization - Water, Sanitation and Health

content: Poor waste management can pollute land and water. Waste reduction, reuse, recycling, safe collection, and appropriate disposal are important ways to improve waste management.

Environmental noise can come from road traffic, construction, industry, and other activities. Excessive noise can affect sleep and wellbeing. Recording the time and location can help when reporting a noise problem.
